field.label: Perma-Block enabled
field.help: Permanently block IPs that repeatedly returned to the Self-Defense list after their TTL expired. Promoted entries land in pf table "abuseipdb_permaban" and stay there until manually removed. No AbuseIPDB report is submitted on promotion — that decision stays with the operator.

field.label: Promote after N occurrences
field.help: Number of times an IP must reappear in the Self-Defense list (within the window below) before it is promoted to Perma-Block. Default: 3.

field.label: Window (days)
field.help: Time window across which the threshold counts. Default: 14 days.
